g.text: Activity — customer books a maintenance package (UC04, with UC20, UC21, UC22)
Open the first day that still has a free time,
Show the reference, technician and ticket
Check the dealership has a bay of the
package's type and a technician with its skill
Can this dealership do the job?
Compute the day's start times: a free bay
AND a qualified technician on shift for the
whole job, inside opening hours, after lead time
Start time valid? open day, on the grid,
inside hours, ≥ lead time, ≤ max days ahead
Transaction: read free bays and technicians,
allocate best fit (fewest skills, least loaded)
Lost the race on the bay or technician,
Commit, record CONFIRMED in the audit trail,
(no retry: the customer must pick another time)
